ios.desc:
Jewelcase is a local music player bringing a modern look to plain old music files. Avoid subscription costs and platform lock-in by switching to the ultimate in data portability: files and folders.

Manage your library in Files and play it in Jewelcase

Features:
 • Offline By Default
    ‣ No tracking at all, and no online connectivity unless you choose
 • Private Listening History & Stats
    ‣ See what you've been listening to and when, without sharing any data
 • CarPlay
 • Synced Lyrics in LRC-format
 • Widgets
    ‣ Control playback from the home screen
 • Search
    ‣ Find what you're looking for with fast local search
 • Playlists Are Files
    ‣ Importing/exporting playlists is as simple as copy and paste
 • Equalization
    ‣ Create EQs for different genres which automatically activate when you listen
    ‣ Global gain setting
 • ReplayGain
 • Gapless Playback
 • Sleep Timer
 • Inspect Tags and Metadata
 • ListenBrainz/Last.fm Integration
 • Play local music from Music/iTunes library

Tag Support:
 • Standard ID3 & VorbisComment Tags
 • Multi-Tags (Artist, Genre)
    ‣ With option to specify custom separators
 • Embedded Cover Art

Format Support:
 • Music Files: .flac, .opus, .ogg (Vorbis), .mp3, .m4a, .mp4
    ‣iTunes/Music library supports all formats supported by Music/iTunes
 • Playlists: .m3u, .m3u8
